map.输入房间各墙长与门洞宽度，按周长扣除门洞计算踢脚线净长度，窗台不扣减，便于建材采: Enter each wall length and door opening width of the room to compute the net baseboard length as the perimeter minus the openings (windowsills are not deducted), which helps with material purchasing and quantity estimates.
map.踢脚线净长 = 房间周长 − 门洞总宽: Net baseboard length = room perimeter − total door opening width
map.单房踢脚线：录入四面墙长与门洞宽，周长减门洞得净长，按需加 5% 损耗。: Single room baseboard: enter the four wall lengths and the door opening widths, subtract the openings from the perimeter for the net length, and add 5% for waste if needed.
map.多房汇总：逐房计算后求和统一采购减少接头；阳角处注意切角损耗。: For multiple rooms, compute each and sum for a single purchase to reduce joints; remember the mitre cut waste at external corners.
map.异形户型：凸窗/凹位分段量取，弧段按弦长近似或实测。: Irregular rooms: measure bay windows and recesses in segments, and approximate or measure curved sections by chord length.
map.单房踢脚线净长: Net baseboard length for a single room
map.：示例：房长 4m、宽 3m，1 个门洞宽 0.9m（窗台不扣）。\n• 周长:
: Example: room 4 m long and 3 m wide with one 0.9 m door opening (windowsills not deducted).
• Perimeter = 2×(4+3) = 14 m
• Net length = 14 − 0.9 = 13.1 m
• Purchasing with 5% waste ≈ 13.75 m
map.踢脚线沿地脚走，窗台处通常无踢脚线，故不扣减；仅扣门洞等断开处。: Baseboard runs along the floor line and is normally absent at windowsills, so it is not subtracted; only interruptions such as door openings are deducted.
map.损耗加多少？: How Much Waste Should I Add?
map.直线房间 3%–5%，多阳角/异形 5%–8%。: 3%–5% for a straight rectangular room, 5%–8% with many external corners or irregular shapes.
map.阴阳角怎么处理？: How Do You Handle Internal and External Corners?
map.阳角宜用整根切 45° 对接，阴角直接抵入；切角会额外耗料，估算时计入。: At external corners miter a full length at 45° to join; internal corners butt the length directly. Miters consume extra material, so include that in the estimate.
